picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: Inflation re-accelerating above 4.5% would reshape Fed policy, bond yields, and real wages for households.

picks.question: Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the October 2026 meeting?
picks.why: The Fed's October decision signals how policymakers weigh sticky inflation against a softening labor market.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: A large share of global oil passes through Hormuz, so prolonged disruption keeps energy prices and inflation risks elevated.

picks.question: US Government removes public access to a major Chinese AI model in 2026?
picks.why: Restricting Chinese AI models would mark an escalation in US-China tech decoupling, with consequences for open-source research and trade.

picks.question: Will Anthropic have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Leadership at the AI frontier shapes where investment, talent, and productivity gains concentrate across the economy.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state-level billionaire wealth tax would test capital mobility, revenue estimates, and the politics of inequality.
